text: maya: Heads-up — mkdocs build on staging is failing the linkcheck step. It flags several broken fragments (old anchors) after yesterday's slug normalization merge. Full short log below. sam: Can you paste the exact failing lines? maya: ```text ERROR - mkdocs.plugins.linkcheck - Broken fragment: docs/guides/auth.md#token-rotation -> 404 ERROR - mkdocs.plugins.linkcheck - Broken fragment: docs/sdk/python.md#client-config -> 404 12 broken anchors found ``` jordan: Did we change slugify rules in #4123? That would explain fragment differences (spaces -> dashes, punctuation removed). maya: Yep, merged that yesterday. The new slugs strip underscores and punctuation; older external links still point to the pre-normalized fragments. sam: Two remediation options: 1) add explicit header IDs in the source (e.g. `## Token rotation {#token-rotation}`), or 2) add invisible HTML anchor shims (``) to keep legacy fragments working. Which is less risky? jordan: Header IDs are clean but touch content; shims are minimal and non-intrusive. Note: raw HTML can be sanitized by some mkdocs/plugins or MDX setups. maya: I tried a tiny shim locally — inserted `` immediately above the section in docs/sdk/python.md and re-ran linkcheck; that fixed that fragment locally. sam: Great. Can you open a PR with the shim and a short comment referencing the slug normalization so future readers know why the anchor exists? Also add a one-line case to the docs migration guide. maya: PR 3141 opened: added two anchor shims (auth + sdk) and a one-sentence note in docs/migration.md. Also added a short CI tweak to temporarily whitelist these two until we batch a holistic compatibility shim. @jordan @sam please review when you have a sec. docs-bot: docs/linkcheck job re-run queued — please wait for the CI result. sam: Quick review: lgtm, tiny nit: trailing whitespace on the `` line. jordan: Approved, merging when CI passes. We should follow up with a small script that generates legacy->new slug mappings for external link audit. maya: Filed follow-up issue #3150: "docs: legacy anchor compatibility shim + audit script". I'll add it to the next docs sprint. Thanks y'all :thumbsup: sam: :eyes:
